title: AS2: for..in statement compilation
description: Implement for..in loop compilation in the AS2 compiler (packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts). In AVM1, for (var k in obj) uses ActionEnumerate2 (0x55) to push all keys of an object onto the stack, then loops. Check if it's already implemented by searching for 'forin', 'ForIn', 'ActionEnumerate'. If not: compile for-in as ActionEnumerate2 to push keys, then loop with ActionNextMember or use ActionEnumerate2 + loop approach. Add unit tests.
